manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) for every complete pair. Average equally within each 12-item form stratum, then equally across forms. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable token_delta; value_lo and value_hi are the minimum and maximum tokenizer means. File every finite outcome once regardless of sign or agreement.

manifest.selection: Predicates were frozen before tokenizer exposure. The inclusive and exclusive sets balance obligations, future actions, permissions, advice, capability, and operational domains.
